integrity: The calculation derives exact two-step phase-space matrices. Exact-fraction tests support but cannot replace the symbolic proof; historical equivalence with inaccessible earlier work remains possible. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Exact scalar harmonic oscillator and strictly alternating fixed steps only; no general variable-step, forced, nonlinear or multidimensional stability is implied.
title: Exact two-step stability tongues and unstable-stage rescue in alternating Verlet
